title: FinTradeBench: A Financial Reasoning Benchmark for LLMs

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: FinTradeBench sets a new standard with its structured, protocol-driven financial reasoning tasks, ensuring LLMs master real-world trading logic.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Financial reasoning requires more than structured tasks—it demands adaptability to volatile markets and unstructured data, which FinTradeBench ignores.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: FinTradeBench includes real-world datasets from Bloomberg and SEC filings, giving models concrete context for decision-making unlike generic financial claims.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: No dataset can simulate the chaos of live trading. FinTradeBench’s rigid framework fails to capture the nuance of human judgment in unpredictable scenarios.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Financial reasoning is about intuition, not just data. FinTradeBench’s protocol misses the mark by reducing trading to a checklist.
